YUSSUF AL-QARADAWI The truth has been lost as a result of negligence: Determining the lawfulness or unlawfulness of diversion and arts is propably one of the most controversial issues having direct impact on Muslim society. Many people commit the error of excessive indulgence or negligent ignorance of them. The fact that they appeal to the emotions rather than the intellect makes them vulnerable to narrow- Accordingly, some people are of the opinion that Muslim society should consecrate solely on the service and worship of Allah and hard work . There is no room for diversion or mirth. Singing is totally alien to such a society which forbids Some hardliners contribute to such falsehoods. Their faces always have a solemn, melancholic and ominous expressions. ‘They ascribed their stern and melancholic attitude to religion.
